description_en: Creates a sharing rule for a data source to share it with other workspaces or RAM users
description_zh: 创建一条数据源分享规则，即将数据源分享给其他空间或者子账号使用
name: CreateDataSourceSharedRule

parameters.description_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符。
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，数据源的唯一标识符
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which you want to share the data source. You cannot share the data source to the workspace with which the data source is associated.
parameters.description_zh: 数据源分享到的目标项目空间ID，不支持分享到本项目。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which you want to share the data source. You cannot share the data source to the workspace with which the data source is associated
parameters.help_zh: 数据源分享到的目标项目空间ID，不支持分享到本项目
parameters.name: target_project_id

parameters.description_en: The user with which you want to share the data source. If you do not configure this parameter, the data source is shared to an entire workspace.
parameters.description_zh: 如果指定了SharedUser则表示分享到指定人，而不是到整个项目；不指定表示分享到整个项目。
parameters.help_en: The user with which you want to share the data source. If you do not configure this parameter, the data source is shared to an entire workspace
parameters.help_zh: 如果指定了SharedUser则表示分享到指定人，而不是到整个项目；不指定表示分享到整个项目
parameters.name: shared_user

parameters.description_en:
The environment of the target workspace to which the data source is shared. Valid values:

- Dev: development environment

- Prod: production environment
parameters.description_zh:
数据源分享到目标项目空间环境，包括
- Dev（开发环境）
- Prod（生产环境）
parameters.help_en:
The environment of the target workspace to which the data source is shared. Valid values:

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: env_type
